_comment: Step 1 placeholder items (GAMEPLAY_DESIGN.md §2, §15; D110). Rules ask for tags, not items. weight in kg; stack = most per slot; food = how much hunger one removes (0-100 scale); fuel = minutes one keeps a fire burning; warmth = degrees C a lit station adds close by.

items.name: Stone axe
items.description: A sharp stone lashed to a handle. Fells small trees, slowly.

items.name: Log
items.description: A length of trunk. Burns long; builds things later.

items.name: Branches
items.description: Dry twigs and small branches. Quick to catch, quick to burn.

items.name: Stone
items.description: A loose stone, fist-sized. Fire rings, tools, throwing.

items.name: Plant fibre
items.description: Long grass, pulled and twisted. Cord for lashing and fishing lines.

items.name: Wild berries
items.description: A handful of berries from a bush. A little sweet, a little filling.

items.name: Rough fishing rod
items.description: A springy branch with a line of twisted fibre and a bone hook. Hold it with 7; hold and release the left mouse button to cast.

items.name: Berry bait
items.description: Mashed berries pressed onto the hook. Fish will not bite on a bare hook.

items.name: Dried meat
items.description: Salted, dried strips. Keeps for weeks.

items.name: Notes on Felling
items.description: by Old Berta of the Marsh Woods. "Never fell into the wind, lad. The wind decides where a tree lands, not you." — Take the axe (6), stand on the side you want it to fall, hold the left mouse button on the tree; finish from behind.

_comment_fish: Step 1 fish (GAMEPLAY_DESIGN §5b, D114): waters they live in (ocean, lake, river, pond); stamina = seconds of pulling against them to tire them; pull = how hard they tug (the line wears faster); weight range in kg; dusk = more likely at dawn and dusk. All land as raw fish for now.
